title: Awareness can change while first-order states and performance stay fixed

statements.text: All higher-order variants hold that a change in the higher-order representation alone can change subjective awareness, even if all first-order representations stay the same. Since task performance depends mainly on first-order states, awareness and performance can come apart, which separates the view from global workspace and first-order theories.

sources.quote: or process is sufficient to lead to a change in subjective awareness, even if all first-order representations remain the same
The higher-order view, by contrast, is neutral about whether conscious awareness adds significant utility or immediate impact on behavior and task performance
